1.consolidated_definition: Loción que protege del sol, bloqueador solar. Crema, líquido o spray que absorbe o refleja los rayos ultravioletas del sol. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Estamos en familia, tranquilos, sin alcohol y con mucho suntan lotion (El Nuevo Día, 06-04-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Sunscreen lotion that protects against the sun's rays, absorbing or reflecting ultraviolet radiation. 

Note: El Nuevo Día is a Puerto Rican newspaper, but it has been translated as "newspaper" to maintain the formal tone of a dictionary.

Also, "suntan lotion" is an idiomatic expression in English that refers to sunscreen lotion used for tanning purposes, and it's commonly used in many countries including Puerto Rico.
